facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: gravity release during start-up after maintenance on CV-3102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on CV-3102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. CV-3102 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 17 April 2015 an incident occurred on CV-3102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
